verdict.rationale: Bland documents an official CLI under its SDKs docs that manages the whole account from the terminal: making calls, building and testing pathways, and configuring phone numbers. A probe independently confirmed the CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documentation of AI-agent-oriented details such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.
